pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light interstitial pathways on the neck show a continuous topological graph with distinct junction nodes; thickness and continuity on the lower flank are not clearly evaluable due to pixel-level degradation.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dark mane along the upper neck displays a jagged 1D silhouette with distinct high-frequency peaks against the high-key background.

other_distinctive_markers: Two high-contrast pixel clusters consistent with perched avian organisms (oxpeckers) are present on the dorsal ridge: one on the upper neck mane and one on the posterior rump area.
